name: MiGrid Core
install: PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=true npm install && bash -c 'command -v redis-server >/dev/null 2>&1 || (sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq redis-server); exit 0'

terminals.name: redis
terminals.description: Redis 7 — shared cache/state for the L8 Energy Manager and other services

terminals.name: energy-manager
terminals.command: cd services/08-energy-manager && REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379 PORT=3008 node index.js
terminals.description: L8 Energy Manager — live site-energy telemetry at http://localhost:3008/api/site/energy (Live Site Energy page)

terminals.name: physics-engine
terminals.command: cd services/01-physics-engine && REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379 PORT=3001 node index.js
terminals.description: L1 Physics Engine — charging-session telemetry at http://localhost:3001/api/sessions (Charging Sessions page)

terminals.name: market-gateway
terminals.command: cd services/04-market-gateway && REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379 PORT=3004 node index.js
terminals.description: L4 Market Gateway — market-bid telemetry at http://localhost:3004/api/market (VPP Market Bids page)

terminals.name: engagement-engine
terminals.command: cd services/06-engagement-engine && REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379 PORT=3006 node index.js
terminals.description: L6 Engagement Engine — driver telemetry at http://localhost:3006/api/drivers (Driver Management page)

terminals.name: admin-portal-web
terminals.description: L5 Admin Portal (Vite + React + Fluent UI) dev server on http://localhost:5173 (proxies /api/* to L1/L4/L6/L8)
